title: Core Prompt
description: Schema for Max.ai core prompt YAML files

name.description: Locally unique identifier for the prompt. Only needs to be unique within a skill/pipeline's own namespace.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this prompt does
examples: Generates the final chat message sent to the user after research is complete.

template.description: The main Jinja2 template for the prompt. Supports variables with {{variable_name}} or {{node.state.property}} syntax. Supports all other Jinja2 syntax.

auxiliaryTemplate.description: Optional system-level instructions or context that precedes the main template. When provided, will be used for system messages in chat-based prompts. NOTE: only chat completions will currently leverage/support this field. All other usages (research, narrative, etc.) will ignore it. Supports all other Jinja2 syntax.
examples:
You are an AI assistant tasked with translating English language queries into SQL statements. Use the following database schema to inform your translations:

<schema>
{{database_schema}}
</schema>

templateVariables.description: Common template variable patterns used in prompts
